units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:2:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ</cite> top [read:] <he>אי לי ש׳ מי שכתוב … עקב יבוא לנשכיני</he> woe is me, (I am afraid,) lest he of whom it is written (<cite ref="Genesis 3:15">Gen. III, 15</cite>) … come to bite me; Bab.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a:7">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לי ש׳ בשביל וכ׳</he> woe is me, lest the world grow dark around me, because I have sinned.
<cite ref="Ketubot 12a:5">Keth. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>וניחוש ש׳ תחתיו וכ׳</he> but must we not consider the possibility that she may have prostituted herself while she was engaged to him?; a. fr.

senses.gloss: שמא m. apprehension, doubt, possibility. Ib. 14ᵃ התם ברי הכא ש׳ there she asserts a certainty, here a possibility (as she cannot be certain about it herself). Ib. וקיל ליה ש׳ וכ׳ and he regards this statement of a possibility so lightly that &c. Ib. אפי׳ בש׳ נמי מכשיר even with her uncertain assertion he declares her fit for marriage. Ib. 12ᵇ, a. fr. ברי וש׳, v. בָּרִי; a. fr.
